CITY OF EL MONTE

  MEETING AGENDA
  ENTERPRISE FUND COMMITTEE
  August 12, 2020 - 6:00 p.m.
  Online Teleconference Forum: ZOOM
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82585320462
  Call In Number: (669)900-6833
  Meeting ID: 825 8532 0462

COVID-19 Remote Participation Protocols: Interested members of the public may view the
meeting by logging on to https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82585320462. Members of the public may
provide comment by submitting comments via e-mail to Kristan Lloyd at klloyd@elmonteca.gov by
or before the 6:00PM start time for the meeting. Also, following the completion of the staff
presentation on Item 6(C), the chair will also give members of the public 5 additional minutes to
submit e-mail comments at the e-mail address identified above.

 1.  CALL TO ORDER

 2.  ROLL CALL

 3.  FLAG SALUTE

 4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

 5.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS

  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to 2 minutes
  per person.

  A) Update on approved CIP
  B) Contract submittal GIS Support Services
  C) Contract for Utility Organizational Support Specialist

  6.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

  7.  ADJOURN MEETING
